description: Tier 1 read-only primitive set shipped with mpm. Loaded by LoadBundledCapabilities; merged into SeedCapabilities at init. Operators can ship a custom version by placing bundled_capabilities.json in their MPM_WORKSPACE; the loader reads MPM_WORKSPACE/bundled_capabilities.json first, then falls back to the embedded default.

capabilities.name: list_capabilities
capabilities.purpose: List all live capabilities, optionally filtered by --state and --domain.
capabilities.notes: Day-1 discovery query. Read-only, no args required.

capabilities.name: get_capability
capabilities.purpose: Fetch a single capability by id or name with full state, lineage, and metrics.

capabilities.name: capability_lineage
capabilities.purpose: Show dependencies (upstream) and dependents (downstream) for a capability.
capabilities.notes: Pre-invocation blast-radius check; post-fracture impact analysis.

capabilities.name: capability_health
capabilities.purpose: Health summary: failure rate, fracture count, last invocation, last failure trace.
